sources.page_counting_rule: A page counts as a content page if it carries substantive prose from the report. Cover, half-title, table of contents and blank pages are excluded; the excluded pages and the reason for each are listed under excluded_pages. Front matter that carries real content (copyright page, AI disclosure, foreword, acknowledgments, team bios) IS counted.
